# Every A2A v1.0 wire check the door fails. The recorder in tests/common/wire_recorder.rs
# checks each JSON-RPC exchange the common door helpers make against the vendored a2a.proto, and a
# failing check whose key is not listed here fails the test that made it.
#
# One line per exception, whitespace-separated: <method> <part> <subject> <card> <why…>
#   method   the v1.0 method (or murmur extension method) for header, params, result and event;
#            the name as sent on the wire for method and envelope
#   part     method, header, envelope, params, result or event
#   subject  the qualified message for params, result and event; the header name for header;
#            `-` for method and envelope
#   card     the card whose change removes the line
#   why      the rest of the line
#
# The list can only shrink: the census in tests/a2a_wire_conformance.rs fails when a listed
# exception no longer occurs, so a card removes its lines when it lands.
SendMessage params lf.a2a.v1.SendMessageRequest 27678569 role "user", not ROLE_USER
SendStreamingMessage params lf.a2a.v1.SendMessageRequest 27678569 role "user", not ROLE_USER
GetTask params lf.a2a.v1.GetTaskRequest 27678569 the door accepts tasks/get without an id and answers its active task; GetTaskRequest requires id
SendMessage result lf.a2a.v1.SendMessageResponse 27678569 a bare task, not {"task": …}; kebab-case state
GetTask result lf.a2a.v1.Task 27678569 kebab-case states, artifacts without artifactId, role "agent"
CancelTask result lf.a2a.v1.Task 27678569 kebab-case states, artifacts without artifactId, role "agent"
SendStreamingMessage event lf.a2a.v1.StreamResponse 54148d84 murmur SSE frames, not JSON-RPC StreamResponse events
stream/watch event lf.a2a.v1.StreamResponse 2eea2c25 murmur SSE frames; 2eea2c25 moves the watch stream onto 54148d84's shapes
